name: Yabai! -Fukushuu Yami Site-
original_name: ヤバい！―復讐・闇サイト―
source: Tezuka Ryou recently lost everything: his sister whom he loved intimately, his father due to a fire at his house and now in depression he seeks revenge on the people who caused him all this trouble. He kidnaps the 3 girls that bullied his sister into committing suicide. He then starts to torture them by raping them and live streaming it all so when they confess, the whole world can see it.
translation: 手冢亮最近失去了一切：他深爱的妹妹、因家中火灾去世的父亲，如今他陷入抑郁，寻求向造成这一切的人复仇。他绑架了那三个欺负他妹妹直至自杀的女孩。然后他开始通过强奸她们来折磨她们，并将一切进行直播，这样当她们认罪时，全世界都能看到。
